description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting within the WPEFramework project. It declares structures for warning events and reporting units, including control interfaces for configuration and exclusion of warning categories.

classes.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, capable of serialization, deserialization, and string representation, including categorization and warning status.

classes.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Control interface for managing warning reporting categories, allowing configuration, exclusion, and cloning of warning category controls.

methods.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningEvent::Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the warning event.

methods.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningEvent::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the warning event into a byte array.

methods.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningEvent::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into the warning event object.

methods.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningEvent::ToString
methods.description: Converts the warning event to a string representation.

methods.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningEvent::IsWarning
methods.description: Indicates whether the event is a warning.

methods.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl::Exclude
methods.description: Adds a category to the exclusion list.

methods.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl::Configure
methods.description: Configures the control with specific settings.

methods.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl::Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the control object.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event identified by an string ID.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific warning category, including whether it is default, enabled, and lists of exclusions and configurations.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the list.
